# SeoulBeauty high-resolution category artwork

Generated with the built-in image generation tool on 2026-10-22.
These are decorative category illustrations, not photographs of verified branded catalog products. Actual catalog product images are unchanged.
Web assets: `dist/assets/category-hd/{skincare,makeup,sun,cushion,lip,toner}.webp`.

## Prompt set

The original low-resolution reference for each subject came from `docs/prototypes/assets/`.
Shared prompt (replace SUBJECT with the corresponding subject below):

> Use case: product-mockup. Recreate this low-resolution reference as a new, crisp high-resolution photo-style category icon for SeoulBeauty. The attached image is a STYLE AND SUBJECT REFERENCE only. Subject: SUBJECT. Preserve the recognizable color and object type. Create a single square 1024 by 1024 asset with exceptionally clean edges, realistic glass/plastic/powder texture and soft studio lighting. Front-facing or gentle three-quarter product photography consistent with the reference. The object occupies about 82 percent of image height, centered with balanced minimal margins, wholly visible. Background uniform very pale warm off-white, no rounded frame, no border. Absolutely no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no labels, no other objects. This is decorative category art, not a branded product photograph. It must remain clear at 58px and sharp on high-density phone screens.
